short_name: one profile for the whole fleet
justification: Per-generator differentiation would need AEMO Generation Information per-facility data that is not available to this fork; one profile applies to Tumut Murray Eildon Bendeela and every other Water generator alike.
AEMO publishes no conventional-hydro generation beyond FY2050, so the campaign's 2060 milestone reuses the FY2050 budget; a 2025 or 2026 period reuses FY2027.

A NEM-wide annual total applied to a partial fleet would leave that fleet effectively uncapped, so the constraint is dropped with a warning; every campaign chain is whole-of-NEM so this affects only smaller diagnostic runs.
used_for: Annual energy budget on filtered runs
key: Budget applied when filtered_to_regions is set
